corrections.corrected_statement: You must always yield to trains because a train traveling at fifty five miles per hour takes a mile or more to stop and a train collision is always the fault of the car driver and nearly half of collisions happen at crossings with lights bells or gates and two thirds happen in full daylight and impatient drivers try to beat the average wait of thirty seconds to two minutes and negligent drivers cross without looking listening or stopping with most collisions occurring within twenty five miles of the home of the driver.
corrections.note: Changed half to nearly half to match the page wording.

corrections.corrected_statement: Some collisions and any traffic violation conviction from an Oklahoma court or any out of state court go on your driving record which Service Oklahoma maintains and transfers if you apply for a license in another state.
corrections.note: Changed all collisions to some collisions and specified Oklahoma and out of state convictions.

corrections.corrected_statement: Convictions score two points for license restriction violations and careless driving and speeding and following too closely and disobeying a stop sign or traffic light and failing to yield and driving left of center or the wrong way on a one way street, four points for reckless driving and for failing to stop or remain stopped for a school bus loading or unloading, three points for speeding more than twenty five miles per hour above the posted limit, and one point for operating a defective vehicle and for all other violations except those requiring suspension or revocation action.
corrections.note: Added that the one point catch all excludes violations requiring suspension or revocation action.

corrections.corrected_statement: Every time you use carry borrow or buy a fake identification it is a felony punishable by up to seven years in prison and a ten thousand dollar fine, while it is separately a felony for an authorized issuer to knowingly participate in licensing someone not entitled to a license or who lies on the application or tries to use another persons picture.
corrections.note: Limited seven year prison and ten thousand dollar fine to use carry borrow or buy, not issuers.

corrections.corrected_statement: Some collisions and any traffic violation conviction from an Oklahoma court or any out of state court go on your entire driving record which Service Oklahoma maintains and transfers if you apply for a license in another state.
corrections.note: Changed all crashes to some collisions and removed permanent record claim.

corrections.corrected_statement: Reckless driving and failure to stop or remain stopped for a school bus loading or unloading score four points while operating a defective vehicle scores one point and all other violations except those requiring suspension or revocation action score one point.
corrections.note: Added that other violations costing one point exclude suspension or revocation actions.

corrections.corrected_statement: Liability means you are legally and financially responsible for injury death or property damage caused by you or your vehicle in a collision and the minimum limits are twenty five thousand dollars for injury or death of two or more persons and fifty thousand dollars for injury or death of two or more persons and twenty five thousand dollars of property damage all per accident.
corrections.note: Added that both injury or death limits are stated as for two or more persons and all limits are per accident.

corrections.corrected_statement: The minimum limits are twenty five thousand dollars for injury or death of two or more persons and fifty thousand dollars for injury or death of two or more persons and twenty five thousand dollars of property damage and all the minimum limits are per accident.
corrections.note: Corrected to state the twenty five thousand dollar limit as for two or more persons as printed.

corrections.corrected_statement: The explosive power of an airbag has killed children and elderly adults under five feet tall and if your car is equipped with an airbag on the passenger side the Highway Safety Administration recommends putting children under twelve in the back seat and even without airbags the back seat is at least twenty six percent safer than the front seat because most serious crashes involve the front of the vehicle.
corrections.note: Added the if equipped with passenger airbag condition and the at least qualifier.
